purpose: Define Project-linked feedback and review evidence as contextual work evidence that may feed MeritCore review/recommendation semantics without letting raw feedback directly rewrite Tier or trust.

topics.name: Project Feedback
topics.purpose: Define Project-linked feedback and review evidence as contextual work evidence that may feed MeritCore review/recommendation semantics without letting raw feedback directly rewrite Tier or trust.

semantics.feedback_rule: Feedback is linked to explicit Project, author identity, subject identity and context/evidence.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative feedback enters explicit review rather than directly reducing Tier.
semantics.reviewer_rule: Higher-Tier or otherwise eligible peer review is determined by explicit MeritCore/review policy.
semantics.merit_rule: MeritCore owns the interpretation of feedback into merit/Tier/trust outcomes.
semantics.authority_rule: Feedback authorship does not grant authorization over the subject.

invariants.rule: Marketplace discovery, matching, participation, feedback and visibility semantics remain explicit and do not override Project/Merit/IAM ownership.

hard_gates.condition: raw negative feedback directly reduces Tier without review policy
Project layer rewrites MeritCore Tier directly
